title: cdk-construct-s3-bucket examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-s3-bucket/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — defaults
- comprehensive/ — versioning, lifecycle rules, CORS rules, object ownership, transfer acceleration
- kms-encrypted/ — sseAlgorithm KMS with kmsKeyArn from bridge fixture (divergent: adds KMS grant resources)
- s3-managed-encrypted/ — sseAlgorithm S3_MANAGED

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/s3-bucket-examples.test.ts.
